propositions: The MCP container must provision with the existing pinned opcert environment (9f1c8e42) as the signing principal, using the materialized Ed25519 key from SSM, via a context-local signer binding in the startup path.

Plan-review and completion-verifier op-certs minted by the MCP server must verify against the pinned pubkey in trusted_environments.yaml through the real verify_required_environment path, while certs signed by unregistered keys must be rejected.

An enforce/grandfather mechanism must gate enforcement on the joint pair (verify.require_environment + verify.opcert_enforce_since): tickets closed after the boundary without valid completion-verifier certs fail enforcement, while pre-boundary closes are grandfathered (advisory).

The authoritative rebar.toml [verify] enforcement flip is deferred to a human-run operator runbook and must not be committed in this stack, to prevent retroactive merge-gate failures on local-CLI closes before the MCP signer is the close path.
Unsetting verify.require_environment must restore advisory-everywhere behavior and leave existing opcert-minted certs verifying (rollback oracle).

The solution is fully additive and reversible: no new environment or key material is created, no new trusted_environments.yaml entry is added, and the binding only routes the pinned key when the env is provisioned.
